ex_en: The old village had almost no crime before the road was cut.
ex_zh: 路修通之前这个村子几乎没有犯罪。

ex_en: The low bridge is closed whenever the river runs high.
ex_zh: 水位一涨，那座矮桥就封了。

ex_en: We expected the bus, but it came twice as late.
ex_zh: 我们本来在等巴士，可它晚了一倍才到。

ex_en: The local guide walked with us for the whole valley.
ex_zh: 当地向导陪我们走完了整条谷。

ex_en: Mark the ferry days on the calendar before the rain begins.
ex_zh: 下雨前把渡船的日子标在日历上。

ex_en: Sorry to bother you, but the gate is still shut.
ex_zh: 抱歉打扰一下，可是那扇门还锁着。

ex_en: The old songs stay with him forever, even far from home.
ex_zh: 那些老歌永远跟着他，哪怕远离家乡。

ex_en: Explain the long rule in one short sentence and we will follow it.
ex_zh: 用一句话把那条规定说清，我们就照做。

ex_en: The design of this small boat is old but still perfect here.
ex_zh: 这条小船的设计很老，但在这里依然合用。

ex_en: We climbed the hill slowly to see the whole valley at once.
ex_zh: 我们慢慢爬上山坡，好一次看尽整条谷。

ex_en: The straight road looks longer than the narrow path beside it.
ex_zh: 那条笔直的路比旁边的窄路看着更长。

ex_en: They train the young horses for two years before the long trip.
ex_zh: 长途出行之前他们要先把小马驯两年。

ex_en: Every seeker in that room asked the same simple question.
ex_zh: 屋里每个寻求者都问了同一个简单问题。

ex_en: The old picture shows the bridge before the flood.
ex_zh: 那张老照片拍的是洪灾之前的桥。

ex_en: The rice smells sweet from the field where it was dried.
ex_zh: 晒谷场上那批米闻着是甜的。

ex_en: It is a wise choice to rest before the long climb.
ex_zh: 长爬之前先休息是明智的选择。

ex_en: Compare the two samples and you will see the difference at once.
ex_zh: 把两份样品一比，差别立刻就看出来了。

ex_en: Prepare the long rope tonight; the ferry leaves at dawn.
ex_zh: 今晚把长绳子准备好，渡船天亮就走。

ex_en: The beauty of this valley is hard to describe in a few words.
ex_zh: 这条谷的美很难用几句话讲清。

ex_en: The scientific name of this plant appears on the old label.
ex_zh: 这株植物的学名印在那张旧标签上。

ex_en: The daily walk along the river is part of his routine now.
ex_zh: 每天沿河散步如今已是他的日常。

ex_en: A common misunderstanding delayed the whole plan by a week.
ex_zh: 一个常见的误会把整盘计划拖了一周。

ex_en: The kid fell asleep during the long speech in the square.
ex_zh: 广场上那个小孩听长讲话听得睡着了。

ex_en: It is two kilometers from the last house to the school.
ex_zh: 从最后那户人家到学校有两公里。

ex_en: The old song became popular again after the festival.
ex_zh: 节庆之后那首老歌又流行起来。

ex_en: The wind from the south brought the rain before evening.
ex_zh: 南风在傍晚前把雨带来了。

ex_en: Avoid the long road on days when the bridge is shut.
ex_zh: 桥封的那些天别走那条长路。

ex_en: The trip to the far village took the whole morning.
ex_zh: 去那个远村的一趟路花了整个上午。

ex_en: The peaceful valley kept its silence through the long summer.
ex_zh: 那条宁静的山谷整个夏天都保着它的安静。

ex_en: The old mode of travel was walking, and it still works here.
ex_zh: 过去出行靠走，这种方式在这里依旧管用。

ex_en: This wet season gave the field a chance to rest.
ex_zh: 这雨季让那块地有了歇一歇的机会。

ex_en: Think differently and the long wait becomes a slow walk.
ex_zh: 换个思路想，这段漫长的等待就成了慢走。

ex_en: The mechanism of the old pump needs only a small repair.
ex_zh: 那台旧抽水机的机构只需小修。

ex_en: The unpleasant smell came from the water behind the village.
ex_zh: 那股难闻的味道是从村后那片水里来的。

ex_en: The old worker's wisdom showed in one short sentence.
ex_zh: 那位老工人的智慧就体现在一句话里。

ex_en: This method of drying rice takes one extra week.
ex_zh: 这种晒谷的方法要多花一周。

ex_en: The cost of the mistake was a whole season of work.
ex_zh: 那个错误的代价是一整个季节的活儿。

ex_en: We drink fresh water only from the spring above the village.
ex_zh: 我们只喝村上那个泉里的新鲜水。

ex_en: The old kingdom kept its rules long after the road arrived.
ex_zh: 路修进来之后，那个旧王国还守着它的规矩很久。

ex_en: The product is simple: salt from the lake, packed by hand.
ex_zh: 这产品很简单：湖盐，手工装袋。

ex_en: He recently opened a small shop next to the old well.
ex_zh: 他最近在老井旁开了一家小店。

ex_en: The couple walked the whole shore every evening for years.
ex_zh: 那对夫妇连着多年每天傍晚走完整条海岸。

ex_en: Finishing the work before the rain seemed impossible last night.
ex_zh: 昨晚看来要在雨前干完根本不可能。

ex_en: Dear friend, the long road is lighter when you write.
ex_zh: 亲爱的朋友，你一写信，漫长的路就轻了。

ex_en: The price of the boat doubled after the storm damage.
ex_zh: 那船被风暴损毁之后，价格翻了一倍。

ex_en: The old trap near the river still catches wild fish.
ex_zh: 河边那个旧陷阱仍能捉到野鱼。

ex_en: She smiled before she spoke, and the room grew quiet.
ex_zh: 她先笑了一下才开口，屋里就安静下来。

ex_en: The guard left the gun outside the old temple door.
ex_zh: 守卫把枪留在那座古庙门外。

ex_en: They achieved more in one season than in the whole last year.
ex_zh: 一个季节干完的活儿比去年全年还多。

ex_en: The middle bus stop is the only shelter for miles.
ex_zh: 中间那个站是好几英里内唯一的避雨处。

ex_en: Few trees survived the long drought in this area.
ex_zh: 这片区域里没几棵树熬过那个长旱。

ex_en: The old group will perform at dawn by the river.
ex_zh: 那支老乐队会在河边天亮时表演。

ex_en: The old bridge limits the speed of every car that crosses.
ex_zh: 那座老桥限制了所有过桥车的速度。

ex_en: The wild horses came down to the water every evening.
ex_zh: 那些野马每天傍晚都会下来饮水。

ex_en: Every small detail of the old wall was drawn by hand.
ex_zh: 那面老墙的每个细节都是手绘的。

ex_en: The insect on the window was smaller than a coin.
ex_zh: 窗上那只昆虫比硬币还小。

ex_en: The atom in this old textbook is drawn far too large.
ex_zh: 这本老课本里的原子画得太大了。

ex_en: The ring was made of a mixed metal, not gold.
ex_zh: 那只戒指是合金做的，不是黄金。

ex_en: We must replace the rope before the next long climb.
ex_zh: 下次长爬之前得把绳子换掉。

ex_en: The whole village came out to welcome the late bus.
ex_zh: 全村人都出来欢迎那班迟到的巴士。

ex_en: The old bell reminds everyone that the work starts at dawn.
ex_zh: 那口老钟提醒大家，活儿天亮就开始。

ex_en: He took a quiet interest in the old maps of the valley.
ex_zh: 他对方位那条谷的老地图很有兴趣。

ex_en: Her strength came from the long walks, not from the food.
ex_zh: 她的力气来自长期散步，不是来自吃的。

ex_en: We received the letters only after the road reopened.
ex_zh: 路重新通了之后我们才收到信。

ex_en: Fortunately, the rain stopped before the long field work began.
ex_zh: 幸好活儿开始时雨就停了。

ex_en: He accepted the small job without asking for more.
ex_zh: 他接下了那份小活儿，没再多加要求。

ex_en: The voice from the loudspeaker woke the whole street.
ex_zh: 喇叭里的声音把整条街都吵醒了。

ex_en: For convenience, the shop opens early on market days.
ex_zh: 为图方便，集市那天店开得早。

ex_en: Only one person can operate this old machine.
ex_zh: 这台旧机器只有一个人会操作。

ex_en: The old tree represents the whole history of the village.
ex_zh: 那棵老树代表着整个村子的一段历史。

ex_en: An enormous shadow fell across the field at sunset.
ex_zh: 日落时一道巨大的影子横过整片田。

ex_en: The old coat is comfortable but too long for the night walk.
ex_zh: 这件旧外套很舒服，但夜路穿太长。

ex_en: His commitment to the long walk showed in the first week.
ex_zh: 第一周就看得出他对长跑的承诺。

ex_en: The ancient well still supplies the whole street with water.
ex_zh: 那口古井至今还供整条街用水。

ex_en: Please give one specific example from the long meeting.
ex_zh: 请从那次长会上举一个具体的例子。

ex_en: The effect of the medicine appeared only after a long hour.
ex_zh: 药的效果过了一个小时才出来。

ex_en: A thin line of blood appeared on his hand after the fall.
ex_zh: 摔了一跤之后他手上出现了一道血痕。

ex_en: It was extremely cold at the top of the hill before sunrise.
ex_zh: 日出前山顶上极其寒冷。

ex_en: The elephant walked slowly along the road to the village.
ex_zh: 那头大象沿着通村的路慢慢走。

ex_en: The house stood empty for a whole year after the road came.
ex_zh: 路修通之后那栋房子空了一整年。

ex_en: The old dog will bite only if you pull its tail.
ex_zh: 那只老狗只有你拉它尾巴才咬人。
